Ethernet, IPv4, and UDP header helpers for packet build and parse.

# Purpose
This header defines helper types and inline functions for Ethernet, IPv4, and UDP packet headers. The `fd_ip4_udp_hdrs_t` union provides a fixed-size layout for a packet header block, and [`fd_ip4_udp_hdr_init`](<#fd_ip4_udp_hdr_init>) fills it with default values for an Ethernet frame that carries an IPv4 packet with no options and a UDP datagram. The file also defines `fd_ip4_port_t` as a compact network-order address and port pair. The [`fd_ip4_udp_hdr_strip`](<#fd_ip4_udp_hdr_strip>) function parses a packet buffer, checks basic header and length fields, and returns pointers to the Ethernet, IPv4, UDP, and payload areas when the packet is valid.
